_about: Public-domain Theodor Keim (1825-1878, Zürich and Giessen) in English for the Word Hoard: The History of Jesus of Nazara in six volumes in the Theological Translation Fund Library (London: Williams and Norgate, 1876-1883), tr. Arthur Ransom and E. M. Geldart, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 31 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
